mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 50% of instances when RSAFS declines > 1% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 70% of instances when UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative or unchanged in > 60% of instances when INDPRO increases > 1% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the CPIAUCSL is above 2% YoY, the combination signals a potential overheating economy with loose monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative or unchanged in > 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3% in one month, coupled with an increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200k, signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases > 0.3% and PAYEMS increases > 200k in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative or unchanged in > 60% of instances when UNRATE decreases > 0.3% and PAYEMS increases > 200k in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 5% signals strengthening demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative or unchanged in > 60% of instances when HOUST increases > 5% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, when the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases by more than 0.5% in 3 months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS increases > 0.5% in 3 months.
